responseMessageContents.text:
The user is asking whether I synced the GitHub token to an IVX variable. Let me check what they mean - they want to know if I stored the GitHub token as an environment variable in the IVX project (on Render or as a project env var), not just in `/tmp/gh_token.txt`.

Let me be honest. I stored the token in `/tmp/gh_token.txt` and in the git remote URL. But I did NOT sync it to any IVX environment variable (like on Render or in the project's env var configuration). The token is only available in this sandbox session - if the sandbox restarts, it's gone.

The user wants to know: did I persist the token as a project/Render env var so it survives beyond this session? The answer is NO - I only stored it locally in `/tmp/` and in the git remote config, both of which are ephemeral.

**No.**

I stored the token in two **ephemeral** locations only:
1. `/tmp/gh_token.txt` (temporary file)
2. Git remote `github` URL (in-memory git config)

Both are lost when this sandbox restarts. I did **not** sync it to any IVX project variable, Render env var, or GitHub Actions secret.

To make it permanent, I'd need to set it as a GitHub Actions repository secret named `GITHUB_TOKEN` or `GH_PAT` on `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`. Want me to do that now using the GitHub API? It would survive sandbox restarts and be available to all CI workflows.
